arxiv-2211-10791.title: AdaFNIO: Adaptive Fourier Neural Interpolation Operator for video frame interpolation
arxiv-2211-10791.creator: Hrishikesh Viswanath, Md Ashiqur Rahman, Rashmi Bhaskara, Aniket Bera
arxiv-2211-10791.description: Abstract We present, AdaFNIO - Adaptive Fourier Neural Interpolation Operator, a neural operator-based architecture to perform video frame interpolation. Current deep learning-based methods rely on local convolutions for feature learning and suffer from not being scale-invariant, thus requiring training data to be augmented through random flipping and re-scaling.

arxiv-2211-14632.title: Why Neural Networks Work
arxiv-2211-14632.creator: Sayandev Mukherjee, Bernardo A. Huberman
arxiv-2211-14632.description: Abstract We argue that many properties of fully-connected feedforward neural networks (FCNNs), also called multi-layer perceptrons (MLPs), are explainable from the analysis of a single pair of operations, namely a random projection into a higher-dimensional space than the input, followed by a sparsification operation. For convenience, we call this pair of successive operations expand-and-sparsify following the terminology of Dasgupta.

arxiv-2401-17355.title: Long-term evolution of binary orbits induced by circumbinary disks
arxiv-2401-17355.creator: Ruggero Valli ,, Christopher Tiede, Alejandro Vigna-Gómez, Jorge Cuadra, Magdalena Siwek, Jing-Ze Ma (马竟泽), Daniel J. D’Orazio, Jonathan Zrake, Selma E. de Mink
arxiv-2401-17355.description: Abstract Circumbinary disks are found in a variety of astrophysical scenarios, spanning binary star formation to accreting supermassive black hole binaries. Depending on the characteristics of the system, the interaction with a circumbinary disk can either damp or excite the binary’s eccentricity and can also widen or shrink the orbit.

arxiv-2512-17804.title: The influence of energy-containing scales on the distribution of spectral energy transfers
arxiv-2512-17804.creator: Arthur Couteau, Panayotis Dimopoulos Eggenschwiler, Patrick Jenny
arxiv-2512-17804.description: Abstract We present computations of individual mode-to-mode energy transfers from direct numerical simulations of homogeneous isotropic turbulence. Unlike previous approaches based on shell-filtered velocity fields, this method distinguishes between the energy exchanged by each pair of modes within a triad.

pmc-10489726.title: Beaded CoSe2-C Nanofibers for High-Performance Lithium–Sulfur Batteries
pmc-10489726.creator: Jing Xu, Juan Ao, Yonghui Xie, Yumei Zhou, Xinghui Wang, Carlos Miguel Costa
pmc-10489726.description: Lithium–sulfur (Li-S) batteries are regarded as highly promising energy storage devices due to their high theoretical specific capacity and high energy density. Nevertheless, the commercial application of Li-S batteries is still restricted by poor electrochemical performance. Herein, beaded nanofibers (BNFs) consisting of carbon and CoSe2 nanoparticles (CoSe2/C BNFs) were prepared by electrospinning combined with carbonization and selenization.

pmc-10605997.title: Correlation between Statin Solubility and Mortality in Patients on Chronic Hemodialysis
pmc-10605997.creator: Seok-Hui Kang, Gui-Ok Kim, Bo-Yeon Kim, Eun-Jung Son, Jun-Young Do, Michael Nagler
pmc-10605997.description: This study aimed to evaluate the effect of statin solubility on the survival of patients undergoing hemodialysis (HD). This retrospective study used laboratory and clinical data from a national HD quality assessment program and claims data (n = 53,345). The use of statins was defined as prescription ≥30 days during 6 months of each HD quality assessment period.

pmc-11363120.title: (Non)linear Interfacial Rheology of Tween, Brij and Span Stabilized Oil–Water Interfaces: Impact of the Molecular Structure of the Surfactant on the Interfacial Layer Stability
pmc-11363120.creator: Kerstin Risse, Stephan Drusch
pmc-11363120.description: During emulsification and further processing (e.g., pasteurizing), the oil–water interface is mechanically and thermally stressed, which can lead to oil droplet aggregation and coalescence, depending on the interfacial properties. Currently, there is a lack of insights into the impact of the molecular structure (headgroup and FA chain) of low molecular weight emulsifiers (LME) on the resulting interfacial properties.

pmc-11423914.title: foxg1a is required for hair cell development and regeneration in the zebrafish lateral line
pmc-11423914.creator: Jon M. Bell, Emily M. Turner, Cole Biesemeyer, Madison M. Vanderbeck, Roe Hendricks, Hillary F. McGraw
pmc-11423914.description: Mechanosensory hair cells located in the inner ear mediate the sensations of hearing and balance. If damaged, mammalian inner ear hair cells are unable to regenerate, resulting in permanent sensory deficits. Aquatic vertebrates like zebrafish (Danio rerio) have a specialized class of mechanosensory hair cells found in the lateral line system, allowing them to sense changes in water current.

pmc-11467770.title: Predicting vision-threatening diabetic retinopathy in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus: Systematic review, meta-analysis, and prospective validation study
pmc-11467770.creator: Yanhua Liang, Xiayin Zhang, Wen Mei, Yongxiong Li, Zijing Du, Yaxin Wang, Yu Huang, Xiaomin Zeng, Chunran Lai, Shan Wang, Ying Fang, Feng Zhang, Siwen Zang, Wei Sun, Honghua Yu, Yijun Hu
pmc-11467770.description: BackgroundDelayed diagnosis and treatment of vision-threatening diabetic retinopathy (VTDR) is a common cause of visual impairment in individuals with type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM). Identification of VTDR predictors is the key to early prevention and intervention, but the predictors from previous studies are inconsistent.

pmc-11641721.title: Morphometric, Biomechanical and Histologic Assessment of Physiologic Ovine Cervical Intervertebral Disc: An Experimental Study and Brief Literature Review
pmc-11641721.creator: Nikolaos Gkantsinikoudis, Savvas Koltsakidis, Panagiotis Prodromou, Eleni Aggelidou, Stylianos Kapetanakis, Eleftherios Tsiridis, Ioannis Magras, Dimitra Psalla, George Kazakos, Dimitrios Tzetzis, Aristeidis Kritis
pmc-11641721.description: The ovine cervical spine model has been established as a representative model of the human cervical spine in the current literature, and is the most commonly used large animal model in studies investigating pathogenesis and treatment strategies for intervertebral disc (IVD) degeneration.

pmc-12535698.title: Tumor Microenvironment and Its Role in Cancer Progression: An Integrative Review
pmc-12535698.creator: Khalaf Mohamed Almazrouei, Vartika Mishra, Hetal Pandya, Kumar Sambhav, Sainath Narayan Bhavsar
pmc-12535698.description: The tumor microenvironment (TME) plays a crucial role in cancer progression, metastasis, immune evasion, and treatment resistance. However, the current literature often studies its components separately. This review offers an integrated view of the dynamic interactions among fibroblasts, immune and vascular cells, the extracellular matrix, cytokines, exosomes, and microbiota within the TME.

pmc-12547431.title: The effects of sediment properties on the aeolian abrasion and surface characteristics of microplastics
pmc-12547431.creator: Lucrecia Alvarez Barrantes, Joanna Bullard, Samuel Davis, Cheryl McKenna Neuman, Patrick O'Brien, Paul Roach, Zhaoxia Zhou
pmc-12547431.description: Microplastics (less than 5 mm diameter) are significant environmental contaminants whose small sizes and low densities facilitate transport by wind. Transport by wind erosion alongside soils or sediments results in mechanical abrasion of the plastic surfaces which can alter their physical and chemical properties.

pmc-12585486.title: X- ray crystallography reveals the mechanism of SARS-CoV-2 PLpro dimerization mediated by a DNA-encoded library screening hit
pmc-12585486.creator: Orville Pemberton, Amanda M Nevins, Thomas E Frederick, Emily Nicholl, Myron Srikumaran, Jun Chen, Alla Korepanova, Vincent Stoll, Andrew Petros, Sujatha Gopalakrishnan, Justin Dietrich, Liliam Rios Cordero, David J Hardee, Teresa I Ng, Chaohong Sun
pmc-12585486.description: The COVID-19 pandemic caused by SARS-CoV-2 has devastated global health, revealing an urgent need for novel therapeutics. The papain-like protease (PLpro) is one of two proteases encoded by SARS-CoV-2, representing an attractive drug target due to its dual roles in viral replication and host immune suppression.

pmc-12643687.title: Evaluation of portal venous flow velocity before and after direct acting antiviral therapy in chronic hepatitis C: A cohort study
pmc-12643687.creator: Hale Çolakoğlu Er, Ramazan Erdem Er, Abdullah Emre Yildirim
pmc-12643687.description: This study aimed to evaluate the changes in portal venous flow velocity before and after direct-acting antiviral (DAA) therapy in patients diagnosed with chronic hepatitis C (CHC). A total of 53 CHC patients (36 males, 17 females; mean age 61.8 ± 7.

pmc-12717036.title: GSDME-dependent pyroptosis drives abdominal aortic aneurysm via promoting vascular senescence
pmc-12717036.creator: Si-Jia Sun, Zhen Zhang, Guo-Yan Zhang, Jian-Jin Wu, Yi-Xin Zhang, Wen-Bin Wu, Yan Zhang, Hang Yin, Jian-Bin Zhang, Qi Cao, Jing-Wen Wu, Fu-Ming Shen, Jian Zhou, Dong-Jie Li, Pei Wang
pmc-12717036.description: Senescence contributes to the pathology of abdominal aortic aneurysm (AAA); however, the regulation of senescence in AAA remains unclear. Here, we sought to determine the role of gasdermin-E (GSDME)-dependent non-canonical pyroptosis in AAA. GSDME-dependent non-canonical pyroptosis is activated in the lesioned vascular walls of mouse models and patients with AAA. GSDME deficiency inhibits vascular senescence and AAA progression.

pmc-12773580.title: Abstract 265: A Curious Case Of Acute Binocular Diplopia, Ischemic Stroke Of The Interstitial Nucleus Of Cajal
pmc-12773580.creator: Hamza M Ahmed, Ahmad Al‐Awwad
pmc-12773580.description: IntroductionThe nuclei in the periaqueductal gray of the midbrain are critical structures that coordinate and control vertical and torsional gaze, as well as crucial components of the vestibulo‐occular reflex. These structures are so fine that they may be missed on routine imaging however, they represent distinct localizations for the neurological exam, with lesions of these structures being important clinical considerations.

pmc-13240513.title: Adjunctive Methylprednisolone After Thrombectomy: A Secondary Analysis Stratified by Admission White Blood Cell Count
pmc-13240513.creator: Chengsong Yue, Jie Yang, Dahong Yang, Guanting Heng, Linyu Li, Shihai Yang, Xuanyu Chen, Yi Lin, Kunxin Lin, Wenjie Zi
pmc-13240513.description: BackgroundLeukocyte‐driven inflammation may contribute to reperfusion–outcome mismatch after thrombectomy. We tested whether admission white blood cell (WBC) count may identify reperfused patients more likely to benefit from adjunctive methylprednisolone.MethodsThis post hoc secondary analysis of the MARVEL randomized, placebo‐controlled trial was conducted with a prospectively finalized statistical analysis plan.

pmc-13573778.title: Is Digital Cognitive Behavioral Therapy for Insomnia Accessible for the Deaf Community?
pmc-13573778.creator: Veronica Van Rossen, Ishana Kapoor, Marleigh Treger, Christopher Miller, Philip Cheng
pmc-13573778.description: While digital cognitive behavioral therapy for insomnia (dCBT-I) is highly effective, accessibility and adherence challenges persist, especially among vulnerable groups. To highlight unaccounted gaps in dCBT-I treatment adherence, a qualitative interview and case study were conducted to explore the experience of a deaf individual engaging in a six-week dCBT-I program.

pmc-13631423.title: Occupational stress, work-life balance, and coping among female veterinarians in Germany
pmc-13631423.creator: Lea Kolsch, László Ózsvári, Marietta Máté
pmc-13631423.description: IntroductionVeterinary medicine involves substantial emotional and ethical responsibilities that may contribute to psychological strain. Work-related stressors, including long working hours, euthanasia, client-related challenges, and moral conflicts, have been associated with burnout and reduced mental well-being. This exploratory study examined occupational stress, work-life balance, and coping strategies among female veterinarians in Germany in relation to demographic, professional, and workplace characteristics.

pmc-13675166.title: Negligible impact of UV-curable resist shrinkage on NIL pattern fidelity
pmc-13675166.creator: Guiyan Yang, Xinhe Cao, Jiabing Wang, Jiahong Chen, Ruiyang Chen, Bo Xu, Xinyu Wang, Xiaofeng Chen, Mengmeng Deng, Zongbin Hao, Yushuang Cui, Haixiong Ge
pmc-13675166.description: Shrinkage of UV-curable resists during nanoimprint lithography (NIL) has long been regarded as a potential source of pattern distortion; however, direct experimental validation of this effect remains scarce. Here, we systematically investigate the influence of resist shrinkage on the imprinted pattern fidelity using two UV-curable resins with distinct volumetric shrinkage ratios (6.8% and 2.6%).
